text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends prohibiting standing at all times on the east side of Scunthorpe Road, between Sheppard Avenue East and a point 94 metres south. This standing prohibition is recommended to enhance sightlines for vehicles entering and exiting the driveway to the commercial plaza.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect from 2:00 a.m. to 6:00 a.m., November 1st to April 30th, on the east side of Scunthorpe Road, between Sheppard Avenue East and a point 94 metres south. 2. Prohibited standing at all times on the east side of Scunthorpe Road, between Sheppard Avenue East and a point 94 metres south.
